e.title: Forvis 保险人才未来
e.summary: Forvis Mazars：保险业人才未来——精算/保险人才的机会世界
e.body:
Forvis Mazars「What is next for the insurance sector: A world of opportunities for actuarial and insurance talent」：保险业人才未来的专业分析——精算/保险人才的机会。对 RIAA：保险人才市场的专业视角——与 [[hybrid-actuarial-role]]（混合角色）、[[ai-two-track-workforce]]（双轨劳动力）配套：人才机会 + 角色变化 + 市场分化；理解专业服务公司如何看保险人才需求；求职规划的专业参考。

e.body_en:
Forvis Mazars 'What is next for the insurance sector: A world of opportunities for actuarial and insurance talent': a professional analysis of the insurance-talent future — opportunities for actuarial/insurance talent. For RIAA: a professional view of the insurance talent market — with [[hybrid-actuarial-role]] (hybrid roles) and [[ai-two-track-workforce]] (two-track workforce) it frames talent opportunities + role changes + market divergence; understand how professional-services firms see insurance-talent demand; a professional reference for career planning.
